gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients newly diagnosed with glioblastoma either by imaging or pathology testing, Gross total resection equal to or greater than 80%.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study was designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, efficacy and pharmacokinetics of JK-1201I combined with adjuvant temozolomide in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme after surgery and concomitant radio-chemotherapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must finish concurrent chemo-radiotherapy (CCRT) no sooner than 4 weeks and no later than 6 weeks.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic Parameter Area Under the Plasma Concentration-Time Curve for JK-1201I, Irinotecan, SN38 and SN38G

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive JK-1201I as an intravenous (IV) infusion at each 14-day cycle (Q2W) until a treatment discontinuation criterion is met as specified in the protocol.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational irinotecan conjugate/formulation (PK measures JK-1201I, irinotecan, SN38, SN38G); topoisomerase I inhibitor

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide will be administered per drug label.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

source_quote.quote: MGMT unmethylation (only for Dose Expansion Cohort).

coder_notes: JK-1201I has no INN in the record; PK of irinotecan, SN38 and SN38G suggests an irinotecan-releasing conjugate/formulation, so formulation_flag new_formulation (prodrug also possible); the moiety mapping step should check. Plasma-only PK. Two registered cohorts (escalation, expansion), neither a control. MGMT unmethylated required only for expansion cohort; not candidate-matched.
